RoleDescription: A Frontend Engineer focuses on building the visual and interactive elements of websites and applications that users interact with. They work to translate design mockups into code, ensuring responsiveness, performance, and a seamless user experience.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop and maintain user-facing features using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Implement responsive design to ensure compatibility across devices
Collaborate with UX/UI designers and backend developers
Optimize application performance for speed and scalability
Debug and fix issues in the frontend code

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Expect constant changes in frameworks and tools, requiring ongoing learning. Interactions with design and backend teams can be challenging due to differing priorities.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Consistently delivering bug-free, performant, and user-friendly frontend features that align with design specifications and improve user engagement.

RoleDescription: Backend Engineers build and maintain the server-side logic, databases, and APIs powering applications. They focus on performance, scalability, and security to support frontend functionalities and user requirements.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Write, test, and maintain backend server code
Design and implement APIs for frontend consumption
Manage database systems and optimize queries
Ensure security and data protection practices
Troubleshoot and debug server-side issues

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Backend work often involves complex problem-solving with less visible output, which can be less rewarding. Security and performance issues may create high-pressure scenarios.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Reliable, secure, and scalable backend services that handle high loads efficiently and securely supporting business requirements.

RoleDescription: Full-Stack Engineers develop and maintain both frontend and backend aspects of web applications, ensuring seamless integration and performance across the entire stack.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Design and develop web applications from frontend to backend
Integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
Optimize application for performance and scalability
Troubleshoot issues across the entire stack
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Being a full-stack engineer requires staying updated with a wide range of technologies, which can be overwhelming. Balancing depth in frontend and backend can dilute expertise.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Efficiently delivering integrated, well-functioning applications with clean code, minimal bugs, and positive user feedback.

RoleDescription: Software Engineers apply engineering principles to design, build, test, and maintain software systems across various platforms and industries.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Write, test and maintain codebases
Collaborate on system design and architecture
Debug and resolve software defects
Participate in code reviews
Work with cross-functional teams on requirements

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Software engineering requires constant learning and adapting to new technologies. Debugging complex legacy systems can be tedious and frustrating.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivering reliable, maintainable, and efficient software solutions that meet defined requirements and pass quality standards.

RoleDescription: Quality Assurance Engineers ensure that software products meet declared standards and function correctly by designing tests, identifying bugs, and improving testing processes.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop and execute test plans and test cases
Perform manual and automated testing
Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects
Analyze quality metrics and report findings
Continuously improve testing processes and standards

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: QA work can feel repetitive and underappreciated, though it is critical. Over-emphasis on automated testing tools sometimes overlooks the need for exploratory testing and critical thinking.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Consistently identifying defects early, maintaining high test coverage and contributing to product quality improvement.

RoleDescription: Data Analysts collect, process, and analyze data to help organizations make informed business decisions by identifying trends and patterns.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Gather and clean data from multiple sources
Perform statistical analysis and data modeling
Create visualizations and reports for stakeholders
Identify trends and actionable insights
Collaborate with business teams to define data needs
RequiredSkills: Data Visualization Tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Data analysis often involves cleaning large messy datasets, which can be tedious. Interpretation errors can lead to misguided decisions if not careful.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivering accurate, clear, and actionable insights that drive strategic business improvements.

RoleDescription: Data Scientists use advanced analytical techniques, including machine learning, to extract meaningful insights and build predictive models from complex data.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Collect and preprocess large datasets
Develop and test machine learning models
Perform statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
Visualize data and communicate findings
Collaborate with business and technical teams

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Success demands deep math, programming, and domain expertise; theoretical knowledge alone is insufficient. Results can be unpredictable and sometimes inconclusive.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Building models that reliably predict or classify outcomes, delivering measurable business impact through data-driven solutions.

RoleDescription: Machine Learning Engineers design, build, and deploy machine learning models and systems that enable automated predictions and decision-making.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop and maintain ML training pipelines
Evaluate and tune model performance
Collaborate with data scientists to productionize models
Build APIs for model inference
Monitor deployed models and retrain as needed

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: The role demands continuous learning as the field evolves rapidly. Deploying models that perform well in production is challenging and often requires engineering rigor beyond research.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivering scalable, maintainable ML solutions that improve automation and predictive capabilities with measurable business value.

RoleDescription: Business Intelligence Analysts transform organizational data into insights through reporting and dashboard development, supporting data-driven decisions.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop and maintain BI dashboards and reports
Analyze data to identify business trends
Work with stakeholders to define KPIs
Ensure the accuracy and quality of data
Perform ad-hoc data analysis

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: BI work can be hindered by poor data quality and siloed systems. Insightful reporting needs strong communication to influence decision makers.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Producing timely, accurate reports and dashboards that enable stakeholders to make informed business decisions.

RoleDescription: Data Engineers design, build, and manage data pipelines and architecture to ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data flow for analytics and operational use.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines
Manage and configure data storage systems
Ensure data quality and security
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts
Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Data engineering often involves managing legacy systems and data inconsistencies which can be frustrating. High reliability is expected but difficult to achieve.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivering robust, scalable data infrastructure that supports accurate and timely data access for business needs.

RoleDescription: UX Designers focus on enhancing user satisfaction by improving the usability, accessibility, and interaction between the user and the product. They conduct research and design user flows to create intuitive and engaging experiences.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Conduct user research and usability testing
Create wireframes, prototypes, and user journey maps
Collaborate with product managers and developers
Analyze user feedback and iterate on designs
Present design solutions to stakeholders

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: UX design can be iterative and often requires handling conflicting stakeholder demands. The impact of work may not always be immediately visible.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Intuitive, user-friendly designs validated through research that positively impact user engagement and satisfaction.

RoleDescription: UI Designers are responsible for designing the visual aspects of user interfaces, focusing on look, feel, and interactive elements to create a cohesive and aesthetically pleasing experience.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Design interface layouts and user interaction elements
Create style guides and design systems
Collaborate with UX designers and developers
Prepare graphics and assets for implementation
Ensure visual consistency across platforms

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: UI design requires balancing creativity with strict brand and technical constraints. Work can become repetitive and highly detailed.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Visually coherent and appealing interfaces that enhance user experience and adhere to branding guidelines.

RoleDescription: Product Designers handle the end-to-end design of digital products, integrating UX and UI principles to deliver functional, attractive, and user-centered solutions.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Research user needs and business requirements
Design wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering and marketing
Iterate designs based on user feedback and analytics
Define and maintain design systems

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Product design responsibilities are broad and require juggling multiple skills and stakeholder requests, leading to potential scope stress.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivery of user-centered, aesthetically pleasing, and functional products that meet business goals.

RoleDescription: Interaction Designers focus on crafting engaging interfaces and ensuring seamless interactions between users and products, concentrating on human-computer interaction principles.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop interactive elements and user flows
Create prototypes and interaction models
Conduct usability testing to refine experiences
Collaborate with UX, UI, and product teams
Analyze user behaviors and suggest enhancements

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Interaction design can sometimes be overshadowed by visual or technical priorities; strong advocacy is needed.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Designs that facilitate intuitive and efficient interactions improving overall user satisfaction.

RoleDescription: Frontend Developers implement the visual and interactive parts of web applications, translating design specs into functional code.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Code website and application frontends using HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Optimize performance and responsiveness
Collaborate with designers and backend developers
Fix bugs and improve UI features
Keep up with frontend technology trends

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Must frequently learn new libraries and frameworks; can face tight deadlines and design compromises.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Consistently delivering clean, efficient frontend code that aligns with UX/UI designs and performs well.

RoleDescription: Cybersecurity Engineers protect systems, networks, and data from cyber threats by implementing security measures and monitoring for breaches.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Conduct security assessments and penetration tests
Implement and manage firewalls and encryption
Monitor network traffic for suspicious activity
Respond to security incidents and breaches
Keep up with security threats and best practices

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Constant vigilance required; work can be stressful due to threat exposure and incident response urgency.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Maintaining secure systems with minimal breaches and timely mitigation of vulnerabilities.

RoleDescription: Cloud Architects design and oversee an organization's cloud computing strategy including deployment, management, and security of cloud resources.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Design cloud infrastructure and architecture
Manage cloud migration and integration
Implement cloud security measures
Optimize cloud resources for cost and performance
Collaborate with IT and development teams

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Requires continuous learning of evolving cloud technologies; managing cost and security risks can be complex.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Reliable, scalable cloud architecture that meets business needs while optimizing cost and security.

RoleDescription: DevOps Engineers bridge development and operations teams by automating infrastructure, managing deployments, and ensuring system reliability.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Automate deployment pipelines and infrastructure
Monitor system performance and availability
Manage CI/CD processes
Collaborate across development and IT teams
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Needs strong multitasking under pressure; often responsible for systems under production stress.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Seamless, automated deployment processes and highly available system infrastructure.

RoleDescription: Site Reliability Engineers ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems through engineering and automation.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Monitor system health and availability
Automate operational tasks and incident response
Manage scaling and capacity planning
Collaborate with development teams for reliability
Conduct post-incident reviews and improvements

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Constant on-call duties can be stressful with unpredictable work hours. Balancing reliability and rapid feature delivery is challenging.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Stable, performant production environments with minimal downtime and rapid incident resolution.

RoleDescription: Network Engineers design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure for secure and efficient data communication.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Configure and maintain routers, switches, and firewalls
Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues
Ensure network security and compliance
Plan and implement network upgrades
Collaborate with IT and security teams

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Network issues can impact entire organizations causing high pressure; must handle routine yet complex troubleshooting.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Reliable, secure, and optimized network infrastructure with minimal downtime and quick resolution of issues.

RoleDescription: Product Managers lead the development and lifecycle of products, balancing business goals, user needs, and technical feasibility to deliver valuable solutions.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Define product vision and strategy
Gather and prioritize product requirements
Coordinate cross-functional teams
Analyze market and user data
Manage product roadmap and releases

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Product Managers often juggle conflicting priorities and have limited direct authority, requiring strong persuasion and negotiation skills.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Products that meet business goals with user satisfaction and timely market delivery.

RoleDescription: Project Managers oversee project planning, execution, and delivery by coordinating teams, managing resources, timelines, and risks to meet project objectives.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop project plans and schedules
Manage project budgets and resources
Coordinate team activities
Identify and mitigate risks
Report progress to stakeholders

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Project Managers often manage tensions between scope, time, and budget, with pressure to deliver on all fronts concurrently.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Projects delivered on time, within budget, and meeting defined scope and quality standards.

RoleDescription: Program Managers oversee multiple related projects to achieve strategic business outcomes, ensuring alignment, resource optimization, and stakeholder communication.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Coordinate multiple project teams
Align program goals with business objectives
Manage program risks and issues
Communicate with senior management and stakeholders
Monitor and optimize overall program performance

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Program Managers face complexity managing interdependencies and navigating organizational politics across projects.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Successful coordination and delivery of multiple projects achieving strategic objectives with stakeholder alignment.

RoleDescription: Business Analysts bridge business needs and technology solutions by analyzing processes, gathering requirements, and facilitating clear communication.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Gather and document business requirements
Analyze and improve business processes
Facilitate communication between stakeholders and IT
Support solution design and testing
Conduct impact analysis and reporting

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Often works under unclear requirements with competing stakeholder interests; must manage expectations realistically.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Clear, actionable requirements and improved business processes that enable successful project delivery.

RoleDescription: IT Consultants provide expert advice on technology solutions to improve business processes, focusing on strategic alignment and implementation support.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Assess client IT needs and systems
Recommend technology improvements
Plan and support implementation projects
Train and support client staff
Manage client relationships

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Consulting requires adaptability and resilience; projects can be high-pressure with ambiguous outcomes.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Delivering tangible technology solutions that improve client business processes and effectiveness.

RoleDescription: Technical Writers create clear and concise documentation that helps users understand complex products, processes, or systems.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Write and edit user manuals, guides, and instructions
Collaborate with engineers and subject matter experts
Maintain documentation standards and templates
Update documentation as products evolve
Ensure content clarity and usability

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Requires balancing technical accuracy with reader comprehension; often under tight deadlines.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Clear, accurate, and accessible documentation that reduces user confusion and support requests.

RoleDescription: Content Strategists plan, develop, and manage content to meet business goals and user needs, ensuring consistency and effectiveness across channels.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Develop content strategies aligned with business objectives
Analyze audience and content performance
Collaborate with marketing, design, and product teams
Plan content production and distribution
Maintain brand voice and messaging guidelines

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Requires juggling multiple projects and stakeholders; success is often indirect and over long-term.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Content that drives engagement, supports business goals, and maintains brand consistency.

RoleDescription: SEO Specialists optimize websites to improve search engine rankings, increase organic traffic, and enhance online visibility.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Conduct keyword research and analysis
Develop and implement SEO strategies
Monitor website performance using analytics tools
Optimize website content and metadata
Stay updated on search engine algorithm changes

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: SEO results take time to manifest; requires ongoing adaptation and consistent effort.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Improved search rankings, increased organic traffic, and measurable business growth.

RoleDescription: Digital Marketing Specialists plan and execute online marketing campaigns across channels to drive brand awareness and customer acquisition.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Create and manage PPC and social media campaigns
Analyze campaign performance and optimize results
Coordinate content marketing activities
Manage email marketing and CRM tools
Collaborate with creative and sales teams

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Marketing results depend on many external factors; campaigns require constant optimization and testing.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Measurable increases in online engagement, leads, and conversions against campaign goals.

RoleDescription: Copywriters craft compelling written content for marketing, advertising, and communications to engage audiences and drive action.
DayToDayResponsibilities: Write clear, persuasive copy for various media
Collaborate with marketing and design teams
Edit and proofread content
Ensure brand voice consistency
Research industry trends and audience preferences

CompetencyExpectations.HarshTruth: Copywriting can involve tight deadlines and frequent revisions; success depends on understanding both audience and brand voice deeply.
CompetencyExpectations.WhatSuccessLooksLike: Engaging, clear copy that drives desired audience actions and supports marketing objectives.
